R1.title: A_Complete only after the first sent offer
R1.diagnostic: escaping O_Create Offer -> A_Complete and A_Accepted -> A_Complete
R1.petri_net: first offer moved before the AND-split; offer transitions duplicated for later offers

R2.title: Each validation round starts with A_Validating
R2.petri_net: AND-block around O_Returned removed; O_Returned inside the validation round

R3.title: Pending and denial only after validation

G1.title: Offer sent via either channel

G1.petri_net: one visible transition O_Sent (online only) per send position

G2.title: New offer between validation rounds
G2.diagnostic: log moves O_Create Offer (largest fitness leak)
G2.change: validation loop redo tau -> X(tau, offer)
G2.petri_net: offer transitions duplicated inside the validation loop
